usageNotes: Use this endpoint to modify an existing cluster-level firewall rule in-place by its zero-based position index, or to reorder it via `moveto` (when `moveto` is set, all other body fields are ignored). Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/`; changes take effect immediately on the cluster firewall chain without a daemon restart. Pass the `digest` from the current rule read to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Disable an existing ACCEPT rule at position 3 and add a comment

tips: Rule positions are zero-based; retrieve current positions first with GET /cluster/firewall/rules before updating.
Use `moveto` alone to reorder a rule without changing any of its properties — all other params are silently ignored when `moveto` is present.
The `delete` param accepts a comma-separated list of field names (e.g. `dest,sport`) to unset optional fields on the rule.
Returns null on success; a non-2xx response means the rule was not modified.
Cluster firewall rules apply to traffic between cluster nodes; they are distinct from per-VM/CT firewall rules.
